title: Why he stays with tap dancing
summary: Asked what drives him, Green gives a rambling answer about registration, Showboat and a family head.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: Chuck, there's one question that has always puzzled me, and I think it's a pertinent closing question before you do a last dance. With the whole history of tap dancing, the struggle through tap dancing, the ups and downs of a tap dancer, the ups and downs of show business and public appeal, why do you stick with it? What was that driving force in you that kept you dancing?
Well, there's what you call registration. Without registration there is no force, you see. And there is no censorships to pressures. If you could understand the

physics, I guess, of "Showboat," which is something that we are indebted to for all this new technologies that's going on today. The "Showboat" you see is like a scratch rock is to the injuns, understand?

We must always have a family head. If you're going to be an author, you must have a library, understand? And we must never give out of describing, see, the immensities of compassion, which is some sort of power that God has distributed to, say, our great greats, you understand? Like the higher you go, the closer you see, you see. (inaudible) God's graces and the places to be, see (unintelligible).
